scope: 50 individually judged stranded members; four contextual leaf files also inspected. Parent convictions retained independently. All observations from bytes; no sample executed.
method: atomscan slow/no-follow and cleave facts per file; PHP/JSP/ASP/Ruby source control-flow review, Java rizin bytecode/constant-pool review, all thirty GoAhead initializers disassembled, Mettle native imports and execve inspected.
relocation_audit: ASP.NET output observation moved from webshell file-manager to process/io/stream; exact consumers updated; split redirection and stream reading.

Java acceptance moved from socket/listen to socket/accept; all four exact consumers updated. Parent socket selector membership retained; listener-only selector intentionally loses acceptance evidence. Bytecode now requires ServerSocket.accept, not any Socket-return descriptor.

JVM POSIX shell constant moved from process/create/shell/selection to fs/path/binary; sole exact consumer updated. Parent process-create selectors intentionally lose a bare path; broad fs/path selectors gain it.
Ambiguous cmd-variable atom removed: request source and fixed execution must not imply command flow. JSP local-request binder replaces references; duplicate concat claim removed.

Behinder namespace is notable identity; reflection and AES alone do not establish hostile payload. Narrow Echo exception checks class identity, absent RunCMD method reference, and absent added file/network/class-loading/process-builder operations.
